## What changes

## The three questions (CONTRIBUTING.md §1)
- **Generic?** Who else is it useful to?
- **Already exists?** What did you search, and why isn't extending it enough?
- **Where it belongs:** playbook · skill · template · script · AGENTS.md

## Registered in
- [ ] `PLAYBOOK.md` (stage and/or "The skills", and the one-page checklist)
- [ ] `AGENTS.md`
- [ ] `.claude/skills/VENDORED.md` (skills)
- [ ] `README.md`
- [ ] `scripts/new-project.sh` (if every new project needs it)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` under `## Unreleased`

## Checks
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check.py` passes
- [ ] No real client, product or person is named
- [ ] For process rules: the problem it solved in practice
